unchanged: All R1 performance, risk, cost, calendar, six-configuration budget and test-integrity hurdles remain; no new strategy returns until exact manifests and implementation pass independent review.

statistics.preserve_methods: M3B frozen EG MacKinnon distribution, per-leg level/difference ADF and return CUSUM/fixed-midpoint HAC Wald; level non-rejection is only I(1)-compatibility screening, never proof
statistics.legacy_fixture: 6 synthetic candidates, 44 diagnostic tests = 6 EG + 13 level ADF + 13 difference ADF + 12 stability; this fixture is not the real candidate universe

family.candidate_registry: Before any statistical p-values or strategy returns, build the complete registry from verified historical eligible universe and declared pairs/baskets using the frozen algorithm. Present-day eight-coin probes and 34 provisional candidates cannot stand in for historical eligibility.
family.time_dependence: Freeze a per-decision membership table solely from historical metadata, lagged liquidity, sufficient history and available_at. Include every excluded slot and reason; membership cannot depend on test statistics or profits.
family.units: configuration_id/candidate_id/test_id/leg_id; all six configurations, including secondary, require the same price-relation compatibility tests; duplicate diagnostics across configurations remain explicitly counted
family.counts_per_decision: For N declared eligible candidates and L candidate-leg incidences: EG=6N, level_ADF=6L, difference_ADF=6L, stability=12N; total raw tests=18N+12L. One primary Holm family contains EG+difference_ADF+stability, size 18N+6L. Level ADF remains separately disclosed compatibility diagnostics.
family.arithmetic_example_not_authorized_univer: If all 28 pairs and 6 three-leg baskets were verified eligible, N=34,L=74 => 1500 raw tests, 1056 primary Holm members, 204 EG-only BY comparison members. Current metadata does not authorize this example as a real universe.
family.holm_sort: ascending raw p, deterministic ties by configuration_id/candidate_id/test_id/leg_id; FWER .05 across full primary family
family.by_comparison: EG members across all six configurations only; BY .05 diagnostic only, never substitute for failed Holm
family.missing: Missing expected member or invalid p makes family unavailable; no p-value filling, survivor-only resizing or result-dependent exclusions
family.mandatory_manifest: Before execution commit exact IDs and counts for every decision timestamp, membership/exclusion reasons and digest. Independent review must check actual integer counts against formula; unresolved metadata or missing manifest blocks returns.
family.temporal_limit: Per-decision multiplicity does not prove control across repeated time decisions. Final configuration selection and one held-out evaluation remain separately budgeted; report this limit.

coverage.dataset_distinction: Old M1 frozen snapshot previously audited 79 complete days; the newly collected bounded probe reports 73. Keep separate collection IDs, request dates, raw hashes, boundary grids and exposure records. Do not overwrite old findings or merge snapshots without explicit provenance and independent coverage reconciliation.
coverage.no_fill: No interpolation or zero-filling. Both old and new observed dates remain exposed/quarantined; neither is clean test evidence.

capacity.source: OKX corresponding USDT linear perpetual confirmed daily volCcyQuote row[7], USDT, provider single-reported turnover; do not double for long+short or replace with spot turnover
capacity.window: 30 completed UTC days [decision_day-30d,decision_day); all confirm=1, available_at<=decision, finite nonnegative values; missing/invalid refuses capacity, zero is genuine observation, nonpositive mean refuses capacity
capacity.numerator: Sum abs(actual fill quantity * actual execution price) for all books and both directions of that symbol during UTC day; opening, closing, additions, reductions and reversals all included without netting
capacity.interpretation: participation screen only; no executable-capacity claim without venue constraints and depth evidence

equal_weight_baseline.universe: At each weekly decision, verified globally applicable historical USDT linear perpetual universe, listed continuously >=180 days, with matching verified OKX USDT spot listing and complete lagged 30-day turnover; never infer global history from current live instruments or region-specific announcement first pages
equal_weight_baseline.ranking: Top 8 by lagged perpetual quote-turnover mean; ties lexicographic instId; minimum 6, otherwise baseline unavailable; full membership and exclusions frozen before return computation
equal_weight_baseline.weights: 1/N spot notional, no borrowing; BTC/ETH are not forced past eligibility/rank
equal_weight_baseline.decision: Monday 00:00 UTC using only available preceding completed days
equal_weight_baseline.execution: First recorded daily spot open strictly after decision available_at; with daily UTC opens this is Tuesday 00:00, not same-timestamp Monday fill; same rule for strategy
equal_weight_baseline.missing: No forward-filled prices or fee-free terminal sales. Cash waits for recorded actual fills; disclose open terminal exposure and valuation. Same base/stress execution-cost conventions.

completed_round_trip.unit: one relation-book episode, flat in all legs -> first actual entry fill -> all legs actually flat
completed_round_trip.qualification: All planned nonzero hedge legs must have established the intended hedged position within the frozen hedge-error tolerance at least once; orphan-leg cleanup is reported with its PnL but is not a completed qualifying relationship trade
completed_round_trip.partials: Multiple partial/add/reduce fills inside the same episode count once; shared coins in distinct books are separately attributed, never netted
completed_round_trip.reversal: Close episode only at genuine zero crossing of actual position quantities; new opposite exposure opens a distinct episode. Preserve fill-level attribution and costs; no invented flat event
completed_round_trip.censoring: Unfilled requests and terminal open episodes do not count; preserve losses, fees and unrealized marks. Episodes overlapping split boundaries are purged from count and disclosed, not silently removed from NAV

selection_and_secondary.global_prerequisite: At least 3 of the 4 fixed primary neighbours have positive costed validation CAGR, mandatory before ANY of the six configurations can be selected. If false, no candidate is selected, including secondary.
selection_and_secondary.selection: Among all six configurations satisfying data, risk, positive validation return and global prerequisite, choose highest validation net Sharpe, then lower turnover, then fixed configuration order with primary first. Secondary participates under identical gates and consumes its reserved slot even if rejected or fails.
selection_and_secondary.secondary_formula: For each leg use daily log returns. At decision T, OLS dependent return on intercept plus hedge-leg returns using last 56 complete daily returns with endpoints <T and available_at<=T. Let e_d=rA_d-alpha-sum(beta_j*rj_d). Form 28-day rolling sums of e_d. Center/scale the latest such sum using the last 56 rolling-sum endpoints, all <T; requires 83 daily returns (84 prices). Freeze alpha,beta,mean,sd for an active book; thereafter use only newly available lagged endpoints, never refit active relations. Zero sd or missing history rejects. Entry/exit/break/timeout/weekly schedule and exposure limits are identical to primary.
selection_and_secondary.secondary_source_gate: Exact implementation, fitted quantities, hedge-notional mapping and numerical tests must match this formula and be source-frozen and independently reviewed before any real return calculation; no ad hoc seventh configuration
selection_and_secondary.failed_attempts: Record all starts, rejection causes and repairs. Retry with unchanged configuration is logged, not a new configuration; changed signal/parameter is a new budgeted hypothesis and cannot reuse consumed test.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of aligned daily strategy and baseline return vectors, including no-trade days
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile; report Sharpe, CAGR, drawdown and active return uncertainty; undefined resamples counted and disclosed, never silently discarded
bootstrap.use: uncertainty disclosure only, not a new tuning objective or substitute for point-estimate gates; no post-result block-length choice
